name: The simple planning engine is one self-contained script that holds the Leader's work as one resource graph
asks: Leader utterances of 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-22 (pass general-1): the simple planning engine is a single file, tracks every prompt, types tasks and work as families of relations, defines resources, derives the apps:capability table, plans its own development and discourages wasted work.

x-provenance.recorded-by: general-1 pass of debt-2026-10-09-leader-words-held-in-corpus (Red Cup Engineer Senior)
x-provenance.basis: Leader utterances cited by address; the requirements are an EARS rendering of what those words state and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: Leader utterances of 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-22 (pass general-1): the simple planning engine is a single file, tracks every prompt, types tasks and work as families of relations, defines resources, derives the apps:capability table, plans its own development and discourages wasted work.

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall be the single file dev/apps/simple-planning-engine.mjs, with no accompanying directory of tests, records or documents.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-11 23:34: "I need literally 1 single file dev/apps/simple-planning-engine.mjs"; 2026-09-21 00:44: "the ONLY app I approved of under there"; 2026-09-22 17:02: "a single-script self-contained thing".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall record every Leader prompt, so that its transaction count tracks the prompts sent.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22 17:14: a tool "to log my prompts for days" with 174 transactions for hundreds of prompts "is not even coming close to tracking the right data".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall type tasks and work as families of relations and shall define resources, including packages, engines, customers and employees.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 18:40: "the typing of tasks, work, as like, families of relations, resources, ability to define resources (packages, engines, customers, employees)".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall hold all of the Leader's plans and intentions as one coherent resource graph and shall display one roadmap in its web interface.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 18:40: "start building something that earns us one coherent roadmap ... converting all of my plans and intentions into one coherent resource graph"; no roadmap seen in the web interface.

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall derive the table of applications and their capabilities from the projects it holds.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22 15:33: "an 'apps:capability' table sounds like something the planning engine should derive from projects".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall plan its own development.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-22 17:12: "you can't even use it to plan its own development".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall describe who does what, what resources are involved and what changes, in addition to budget.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 23:53: "waaay too much focus on budget and not enough on who does what and what is actually involved in doing it, what resources, what changes".

requirements.says: The simple planning engine shall discourage work that is unwanted by giving the plan that shows the work is unwanted.
requirements.rationale: Leader, 2026-09-10 23:43: it let a session "burn real USD of tokens on work that was stupid and unwanted ... that's exactly what a planning engine should discourage through, well, giving planning".
